title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the photon frequency nu.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the conservation of energy principle correctly in the context of the transition.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the conservation of momentum to relate photon momentum to the atom's momentum.

title: Correct Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly substitute the expressions for momentum and energy into the equations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the energy and momentum equations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases, such as when Delta is much smaller than M.
